title: Patch: Edwin Van'Spacechief previews its Combo gain
thread:
**Issue #4770 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4770: Patch: Edwin Van'Spacechief previews its Combo gain
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

A player holding Edwin Van'Spacechief in hand will see the bonus it would gain if played now as a number on the card (for example "+2X {4}"), instead of counting up the cards they played earlier this turn by hand. Quickstriker already shows exactly this number, because both cards scale with the same count. Nothing about what the card does changes; the face just stops hiding the arithmetic.

## Why

SPEC section 10.8 says a card whose text computes a number from the board carries that number as `preview`, and ruling R280 exists so the engine does the arithmetic the client is forbidden from doing. Edwin's text ("Combo X: Gain +2X/+2X", base face "Stinkyscape+ #162") computes its gain as a multiple of the cards its controller played earlier this turn, yet its script declares only `conditionMet` and `cry` and no `preview` (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs`). Core #38 Quickstriker computes the identical quantity ("X = cards you played earlier this turn") and does declare one (`crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c038_quickstriker.rs`), so this is a spec-compliance gap with an in-repo precedent, not a design call. The sibling readers of the same count need nothing: Clip Farming Critikal already previews, Rapid Replenish's and Cosmic Bard's numbers are fixed rather than computed. This overlaps none of the open suggestions (keyword order, board scopes, Evasive pricing, stats trackers, the Assault) and none of the rejected ones.

## Proposal

Give both faces of Edwin a `preview` hook shaped like Quickstriker's (`condition_hook` returning one `PreviewValue`), reading the same `played_earlier` count its Cry resolves with so the two cannot disagree, with the value the gain if it resolved now (multiple times plays-earlier). Pick each face's label as a substring of that face's catalog text ("+2X" base, "+4X" radiant), which the cross-card label pin requires. Register the card in the preview pin lists in `crates/cards/tests/cross/preview.rs` and add `r280_...` tests in the card file proving the preview equals the resolved gain on both faces, including the zero-plays case. No catalog text change and no new ruling note: R280 already covers it.

## Where it lands

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs` (the hook plus its tests)
- `crates/cards/tests/cross/preview.rs` (the exact-set and label pin lists)
- SPEC sections 10.8 and 10.9, ruling R280 (cited, unchanged)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Base and Radiant Edwin in hand each carry a `preview` whose value equals their multiple times the cards played earlier this turn, including 0 with nothing played
- [ ] Each label is an exact substring of its face's catalog text, so the label pin passes unmodified in intent
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards stinkyscapeplus-162` and `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cross` pass
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes with no new ruling note needed

## Size and risks

Small: one hook mirroring an existing one, its tests, and pin-list entries; no text, numbers, or rules change. Risk is low: the client renders view `preview` values automatically, so no client work is needed. If the builder finds the label reads poorly on the face, any other substring of the face text keeps the pins green.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45466179359)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Base and Radiant Edwin Van'Spacechief (`stinkyscapeplus-162`) each carry an R280 `preview` in hand whose value equals the Combo gain its Cry would resolve with now: its face's multiple (2 base, 4 Radiant) times the cards its controller played earlier this turn, including 0 with nothing played. Each label is an exact substring of its face's catalog text (`+2X` base, `+4X` radiant). No catalog text, number, rule, or ruling changes.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs` | change | `BASE_LABEL` / `RADIANT_LABEL` consts, a `preview()` hook, wiring into `edwin()`, header-comment sentence, `r280_…` tests |
| `crates/cards/tests/cross/preview.rs` | change | `EDWIN` const, `STINKYSCAPE_PLUS_R280` list, exact-set chain, label-substring loop, label-formula asserts |
| `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` | change | `stinkyscapeplus-162` `zh.previews` map only (no other line of the entry) |
| `crates/cards/chinese.json` | change | Regenerated from the YAML by `export_card_text` (do not hand-edit) |

Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, the engine, `catalog.json`, or any pending fragment (none is needed: the catalog is untouched and the Chinese sidecar claims none per `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` rows 7 and 11). Governing spec, cited unchanged: §10.8, §10.9, and ruling R280 (`spec/rulings/R0280.md`). No new ruling note.

Two corrections to the issue as written: the cross tests (`cross/chinese.rs` R1303 gate) fail unless `card-text.yaml`/`chinese.json` gain the labels, so those two files are in scope; and the issue's `cargo test -p jackioh-cards stinkyscapeplus-162` filter matches no test path (the module is `c162_edwin_vanspacechief`), so Tests below gives the working filter.

## Steps

1. In `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs`, add after `RADIANT_MULTIPLE`:
   `/// R280: the part of the text the value belongs to, on each face.` plus `const BASE_LABEL: &str = "+2X";` and `const RADIANT_LABEL: &str = "+4X";`. Both are exact substrings of their face's catalog text (`Combo X: Gain +2X/+2X.`, `Combo X: Gain +4X/+4X.`).
2. In the same file, add a `preview` constructor next to `edwin`, copying `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c038_quickstriker.rs`'s shape but reading Edwin's own count:
   `fn preview(multiple: i32, label: &'static str) -> PreviewHook { condition_hook(move \|ctx\| vec![count_preview(label, played_earlier(ctx.state, ctx.controller, ctx.self_) * multiple)]) }`.
   Use `played_earlier` with `ctx.self_`, not `cards_played_this_turn`: it is the same function the Cry resolves with, so the two cannot disagree (in hand it returns the turn log's `cards_played`; on resolution `live_self()` sits at its own index, which equals the earlier count). No import changes: the prelude already supplies `condition_hook`, `PreviewHook`, `count_preview`, and `played_earlier`.
3. In the same file, change `fn edwin(multiple: i32)` to `fn edwin(multiple: i32, label: &'static str)`, add `preview: Some(preview(multiple, label)),` to its `Script`, and update `script()` to `base: edwin(BASE_MULTIPLE, BASE_LABEL), radiant: edwin(RADIANT_MULTIPLE, RADIANT_LABEL),`.
4. In the same file's header comment, append one sentence after the `conditionMet` paragraph: `PREVIEW (R280) shows the gain the Cry would give now, the same count times the face's multiple, on both faces.` Leave the R1748003 multiples sentence alone.
5. In the same file's `mod tests`, add a helper and four tests. Helper: `fn previews_and_gains(radiant: bool, plays: usize)` builds `board(radiant, plays)`, reads `let edwin = s.card(ID).id.clone()`, asserts `crate::preview_seen(&s, PlayerId::P1, &edwin)` equals `vec![(label.to_string(), gain, None)]` where `label` is `+2X`/`+4X` and `gain` is `multiple * plays as i32`, then plays `CHEAP` `plays` times, plays `ID`, and calls `s.expect_stats(ID, json!({ "attack": base + gain, "health": base + gain }))` with base 2 or 4. Tests: `r280_base_previews_twice_plays_earlier_and_the_play_gains_it` (`previews_and_gains(false, 2)`), `r280_base_with_nothing_played_earlier_previews_0_and_gains_nothing` (`previews_and_gains(false, 0)`), `r280_radiant_previews_four_times_plays_earlier_and_the_play_gains_it` (`previews_and_gains(true, 3)`), `r280_radiant_with_nothing_played_earlier_previews_0_and_gains_nothing` (`previews_and_gains(true, 0)`). The zero cases prove the `x < COMBO` Cry branch and the preview agree at 0. Use `PlayerId::P1` (already used in this module), not bare `P1`.
6. In `crates/cards/tests/cross/preview.rs`, add `const EDWIN: &str = "stinkyscapeplus-162"; // Edwin Van'Spacechief: Combo gain` beside the other id consts, and after `NEW_SET_PREVIEWED` add `/// R280 formula cards from Stinkyscape+, each proved in its own script file.` plus `const STINKYSCAPE_PLUS_R280: [&str; 1] = [EDWIN];`. Do not put Edwin in `PREVIEWED`: that array feeds `placements()`, which seats every non-Fed-Fauci id in the backrow, wrong for a Unit.
7. In the same file's exact-set test, add `.chain(STINKYSCAPE_PLUS_R280.iter())` to the `expected` chain and extend the test name's tail to name the newcomer (e.g. `…_the_remembering_ones_and_stinkyscapeplus_162_on_both_faces`); the `r280` token stays, so `spec check` still matches it.
8. In the same file, change the label-substring test's loop to `for id in PREVIEWED.into_iter().chain(STINKYSCAPE_PLUS_R280) {` and, in the label-formulas test, add `assert_eq!(labels(EDWIN, FaceKind::Base), vec!["+2X"]);` and `assert_eq!(labels(EDWIN, FaceKind::Radiant), vec!["+4X"]);`.
9. In `crates/cards/card-text.yaml`, under `stinkyscapeplus-162`'s `zh` block (same indent as `name`/`base`/`radiant`), add `previews:` with `"+2X": "+2X"` and `"+4X": "+4X"`. Both Chinese values sit literally inside their Chinese faces (`连击X：获得+2X/+2X。`, `连击X：获得+4X/+4X。`), which the R1303 test requires. Quote the keys; touch nothing else in the entry.
10. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text` (it rewrites `crates/cards/chinese.json`; rerun until green), then confirm `git status --porcelain` shows only `chinese.json` changed among the sidecars (`flavour.json`, `voice-text.json` untouched).

## Tests

- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c162_edwin_vanspacechief` — the script file, old plus four new `r280_…` tests (this is the working form of the issue's acceptance filter).
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cross` — exact-set pin, both label pins, and the `cross/chinese.rs` R1303 gates (preview presence plus Chinese-for-every-label).
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text` — sidecar regeneration and verification, rerun to green.
- `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo jackioh spec check`; `cargo jackioh catalog check`; `cargo jackioh patches check` (all three must pass with no new note, catalog edit, or fragment).

## Done when

- [ ] Both faces preview `multiple × plays-earlier` in hand, 0 with nothing played, and each played gain equals the shown preview on both faces.
- [ ] Each label is an exact substring of its face's text, and the label pins pass unmodified in intent.
- [ ] The three test commands above pass, plus fmt, clippy, and the three `jackioh` checks.
- [ ] The diff touches only the four listed files; no spec, catalog, fragment, or ruling-note change.

## Risks

- `rust (classify)` on the pull request could ask for a fragment. Mitigation: none is owed — the catalog is byte-identical and the hook is a pure view read that changes no game's events, which the classifier's second stage confirms against the base build; if it still flags the card, report it rather than inventing a fragment.
- Fused Edwin needs nothing: a fusion's `preview` list is its ingredients' lists in order by engine code (`crates/engine/src/subsystems/fuse.rs`), and the opponent's view of a hand card carries no preview by `may_preview`, both covered by existing engine tests.
- If a label reads poorly on the face, any other substring of that face's text keeps every pin green; the Chinese value must then move to a matching substring of the Chinese face.

## Open questions

None. Every behavior, label, value, file, and command is settled above; the one judgment call the issue left open (label wording) is pinned to `+2X`/`+4X` with its fallback stated in Risks.
```
